title: California Traffic Collision Analysis
description: PySpark-based traffic safety analysis of California collision data covering severity, weather, lighting, geography, and time trends.
metric: Processed 600K+ collision records using PySpark, Analysed 1.2M+ party records and 800K+ victim records
insights: Identified 15:00–18:00 as the highest-risk collision time window during evening commute hours
Found that 80%+ of collisions occurred in clear weather, showing traffic volume was a stronger risk driver than weather conditions
Identified the 20–40 age group as the most collision-prone demographic due to high commuter exposure
